For each quadrant, take the ENTIRE existing main freestanding structure/cluster nearest the center (all its attached pillars, barrel/stump, solid wall pieces, feet and large rubble belong to this ONE target) and SHRINK ITS WHOLE FOOTPRINT TO HALF ITS CURRENT WIDTH, maintaining the same center of its GROUND FOOTPRINT. Rebuild it as ONE compact protective block/stump/fragment. Keep the existing material and design recognizable. Its entire new width should beabout140worldunits, roughly31%of quadrant width; each quadrant represents453worldunits.
Crucial: FIRST REMOVE THE ENTIRE OLD OVERSIZED STRUCTURE and reconstruct ordinary continuous small paving/earth where it stood. Then place ONE smaller coherent cover there. NO part of the old large object is to survive behind it as a platform, low slab, upright column or big rubble pile. Do NOT add a small NEW object IN FRONT of a remaining big OLD one. There must be exactly ONE standalone target structure per occupied quadrant after editing, not a big one plus a small one. Preserve unrelated distant walls at frame edges and perimeter vegetation, but remove all pieces attached to the original central target mass.
TOP LEFT target a01: one compact solid protective cover,110–160worldunits wide INCLUDING every attached chunk, low90–110units high, same old ground footprint center.
TOP RIGHT target a02: one compact solid protective cover,110–160worldunits wide INCLUDING every attached chunk, low90–110units high, same old ground footprint center.
